made: Every value a release wrote into an identity's config.json and providers.json, by the line it wrote it at (providers.json's list by each entry's name). For each release: its tree at the commit named (its tag, or, for a release that has none, the last commit of main before the next version), with one command added that calls LoadConfig and loadProvidersFile on an empty directory, run once: the files a first start writes, which every later save wrote back with the release's defaults for what the file left out; and its config/providers.json. Releases after these write only what was named, so no default of theirs reaches a file. Remade by TestWriteShippedValues.
